For most households, I’d get the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar panel kit**. Its **2,073.6 Wh battery** is the stronger choice in the results for keeping essentials such as a fridge and CPAP going through a day and night. It’s listed at **$1,199**; the listing says code **DEALECTRIC** takes $59.95 off, though prices and codes can change. [Buy the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit) · [See the hurricane-kit comparison](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-hurricane-season)

One important caveat: **200 W of solar is modest, and storm clouds can sharply limit recharging**—so don’t count on the panel to refill the battery during the worst weather. If you want a lower-cost option, the **BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit** is listed at $729, but has less battery capacity. [Buy the AC180 kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit)

Neither is a whole-home solution; check your appliances’ wattage and plan to reserve power for essentials.
